'''Rector Hoth Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rector]]
* '''Published:''' 8 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-D-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 ECC Rector DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

It contains Mostly hoth stuff, snowtroopers, walkers, At-st's etc... also have Veers inside.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Snow troopers and troopers to give a strong-pack of trooper power. Also give backup with vehicles, creature vehicles and starships.

It gives a small theme for Hoth
